scientific_integrity: General proof supplied; independent finite enumerations corroborate only small cases. Historical priority provisional; earlier Kronecker special case explicitly acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Finite split radical-square-zero quiver algebras over finite fields with no loop arrows; additive associative commutators only. Source Sokal already proves the abstract graph partition function and Nash-Williams the two-forest criterion; present claim concerns their exact identification with commutator geometry and the new chromatic width. An equivalent theorem under bilinear-map terminology could have escaped searches. Independent validation not performed.
title: Chromatic commutator length and Tutte fibers of square-zero quiver algebras
